name: Codex CLI
invoke: spawn the `mps-<role>` agent, or `codex exec "$(mps agents show <role>) <target>"`
notes: Codex has project-level agents now: .codex/agents/<name>.toml with name, description and developer_instructions (the system prompt), plus optional model, model_reasoning_effort and sandbox_mode. `sandbox_mode = "read-only"` is emitted, which is the one place a harness enforces the roles' read-only contract rather than asking for it. The older ~/.codex/prompts custom prompts are deprecated by OpenAI in favour of skills, so mps no longer writes them; project agents need no follow-up copy step, so this entry has no after_install. `model_reasoning_effort` is a fixed "high", not `{effort}` from the neutral role: the renderer's only value-mapping mechanism is `roles.model.tiers` (for model ids), and Codex's own tiers here are empty (`{}`) — there is no equivalent dictionary for effort, and building one for a single field is not worth it while every shipped role is effort:max anyway. Revisit if a role with a different effort ever ships. The official docs page could not be fetched directly (learn.chatgpt.com returned 404 to the fetcher); the format is taken from a reference that cites it — check once against `codex --help`.
